experiment.name: phase1_placement_topup
description: Top-up for phase1_placement (critique C5): the first session was cut
to 4 of 6 repeats by a background time limit. Two more repeats, pooled
complete the pre-registered six. Fresh seeds; identical everything else so
the blocks pool. Each (session,repeat) is its own permutation block.

runs.label: hw08_b
runs.comment: HW 8, 0xD004B080 (original scattered); differed from a by 0.162 W at 3 repeats.

runs.label: hw08_sp
runs.comment: HW 8, 0x11111111 (one bit per nibble, maximally spread).
